## Logo Design in Photopea

Learn browser-based graphic design by building a nameplate and logo in five short projects.

The sequence develops editable vector artwork for signs, labels, slides, and fabrication.

### [Build the Nameplate Text](01-nameplate-text-photopea.qmd)

Make an 11 by 4 inch file, leave room for a logo, and choose readable type.

Correct size, spacing, and legibility prepare a design for real output.

### [Warm-Up: Trace the AA Logo](rough-sketch-to-svg-photopea.qmd)

Rebuild a simple hand-drawn mark with four clean vector lines.

The warm-up introduces editable vector shapes, visual checking, and SVG export.

### [Trace a Multi-Layer Logo](02b-advanced-multilayer-tracing-photopea.qmd)

Trace a landscape sketch as four named vector shapes and export an animation-ready SVG.

Separate layers make complex artwork easier to revise, colour, fabricate, and animate.

### [Combine Logo and Nameplate](03-combine-logo-nameplate.qmd)

Combine the ANDRADE logo and nameplate, then export the complete design.

The worked example shows alignment, proportion, and file-export decisions.

### [Design Your Own Name Tag](../03-laser-cutting/01-name-logo.qmd)

Apply the tutorial skills to an original name-and-logo design and defend the choices.

The project connects digital design, accessibility checks, and fabrication output.
